共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 全て無次元。−Δu=2π²sin(πx)sin(πy)、領域[0,1]²、境界u=0。係数は一定、SEMは直交するアフィン正方形、FEMは既存の規則的な三角形分割。 採用した計算法 SEMはC0連続なテンソル積Qp Lagrange基底・p+1個のLegendre GLL節点と求積、疎な剛性行列・SciPy直接解法を使用。p=2で各方向2/4/8要素、別に2×2要素でp=1〜6。公開済みNumartのP1 FEM・GMRESをファイルのバイト列を保持して4/8/16分割で実行し、両者の自由未知数9/49/225を一致させます。 Compare matched free-unknown counts under h refinement and p=1..6 at fixed elements. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless: -Laplacian u=2pi²sin(pi x)sin(pi y) on[0,1]², u=0 on the boundary. Constant coefficient; affine Cartesian squares for SEM and the existing regular triangle mesh for P1 FEM. Adopted numerical method C0 tensor Qp Lagrange SEM with p+1 Legendre GLL nodes/quadrature, sparse stiffness assembly and a SciPy direct solve. At p=2 use2/4/8 elements per axis; separately fix2x2 elements and p=1..6. Execute the byte-identical published Numart triangle P1 FEM/GMRES at4/8/16 subdivisions, matching9/49/225 free unknowns. −Δu=f,u∣∂Ω=0,u∗=sin⁡(πx)sin⁡(πy),f=2π2u∗−Δu=f,u∣∂Ω​=0,u∗​=sin(πx)sin(πy),f=2π2u∗​ Ke=S⊗W+W⊗S,S=DTWD,W=diag⁡(wi)Ke=S⊗W+W⊗S,S=DTWD,W=diag(wi​) EL2=(∫Ω(uh−u∗)2 dΩ)1/2,EH1=(∫Ω∣∇uh−∇u∗∣2 dΩ)1/2EL2​=(∫Ω​(uh​−u∗​)2dΩ)1/2,EH1​=(∫Ω​∣∇uh​−∇u∗​∣2dΩ)1/2 References and measured quantities Compare with the analytic manufactured sine solution/gradient. Integrate continuous L2/H1-seminorm errors at independent higher-order Gauss points. Check h/p refinement, matched-unknown errors, boundary data and true residuals; save actual2D SEM fields and P1 vertices/triangles/values in NPZ. Verification limits and failures One smooth fixed problem only. Meshes, quadrature and algebraic solvers differ: no speed, complexity or universal-accuracy ranking. The diagonal GLL quadrature mass is not the exactly integrated mass of every product. No curved mesh, singular solution, incompressible flow or Nek5000/nekRS run.
